summary.text: Gregg Hull is the Republican nominee for governor. A small-business owner, he was elected Mayor of Rio Rancho in 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022, becoming the city's longest-serving mayor, and left office in April 2026.

paragraphs.text: Hull has lived in New Mexico for more than 35 years and started and operated two businesses before entering public service.
He was elected Mayor of Rio Rancho in 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022, and announced in November 2025 that he would not seek a fourth term.
Hull won the Republican nomination for governor in the June 2026 primary over Doug Turner and Duke Rodriguez.
